entities.name: HGNC:7648
observations: NBEA encodes neurobeachin, the gene containing the migraine-associated intronic variant rs1160720 reported in bipolar-disorder patients.

entities.name: rs1160720
observations: Intronic NBEA variant associated with migraine among bipolar-disorder patients in the BiGS discovery GWAS: P=2.97×10^-8, OR=1.82, 95% CI 1.47–2.25.

entities.name: Bipolar disorder
observations: The study tested migraine comorbidity within bipolar disorder, comparing 460 bipolar patients with migraine against 914 bipolar patients without migraine.

entities.name: Migraine
observations: Migraine was the comorbid phenotype tested within bipolar disorder; the NBEA rs1160720 signal was not replicated in a follow-up sample of 289 migraine cases or supported in a large general-migraine meta-analysis of 118,710 participants.

entities.name: PMID:25451450
observations: Jacobsen et al. 2015 reported a genome-wide significant NBEA rs1160720 association with migraine within bipolar disorder in the Bipolar Genome Study; the finding lacked replication.

entities.name: NBEA migraine discovery signal
observations: A discovery GWAS in European-American bipolar patients identified NBEA rs1160720 for migraine comorbidity at P=2.97×10^-8, OR=1.82; the result was not replicated and is not established as a general migraine or bipolar-disorder risk locus.
